subject: Retention capacity & dashboard licensing — packaging proposal and discount ask
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference.com>
To: Claudia Vega <claudia@zenhealth.io>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-09-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Retention capacity & dashboard licensing — packaging proposal and discount ask

Hi Claudia —

Thanks again for walking us through ZenHealth's expected telemetry profile last week. Based on the estimated retention window you shared and the trace sample rates for production, I pulled together a packaging proposal that tries to balance predictable cost with headroom for spikes (especially around nightly ETL and large inference batches).

Attached: redwood-observability-sku-2027.pdf (SKU table + small-letter pricing) and zenhealth-usage-estimate.xlsx (what I used to model their monthly TB/day).

High level proposal (first pass):
- Retention: 90-day hot retention for spans/metrics, then 365-day cold archive. Modeled as a blended per-GB rate with a slab for predictable monthly commit.
- Tracing: target 20M spans/day at 10% sampling for prod; will include a small low-latency index for high-cardinality queries.
- Advanced Dashboards: bundled as seat-independent package (up to 30 dashboards, 5 configurable saved queries); if they want unlimited dashboards we can price replacement seats/add-on.

ZenHealth asked for a concession on the observability component given their existing committed spend across inference and want a single bundled discount that covers both retention and dashboards. They also asked whether we can credit unused retention TBs to other months within the first 12 months.

Can you and Ben take a look at the attached SKU and advise what flexible concession path we can offer from a pricing and SLA perspective? Key constraints from our side: any crediting should be limited to a 12-month runway and discounts beyond our standard tier require an internal approval (this is where Jordan's team usually signs off).

Next steps I propose:
1) Internal quick sync today to agree concession band and any conditions (security/compliance impacts).
2) Present a single consolidated quote back to ZenHealth by EOD Tuesday with a clear runway and a defined overage policy.

Thanks —
Olga

--
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0148
From: Claudia Vega <claudia@zenhealth.io>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@zenhealth.io>, ZenHealth Procurement <procurement@zenhealth.io>
Date: 2027-09-19T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Retention capacity & dashboard licensing — packaging proposal and discount ask

Hi Olga —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the attachments. A few clarifying Qs from our end before you finalize the quote: 

1) When you say "blended per-GB rate with a slab for predictable monthly commit", can you show an example where we commit to 8 TB/mo and have a 20% overage cushion? How will overage be invoiced (per-GB or effective per-token equivalent)?
2) For tracing: what happens if we need to temporarily increase sampling to 25% during an incident? Will there be real-time throttles or will we auto-scale and bill retroactively?
3) Dashboards: we want the ability to create 40 dashboards across the team for the first 3 months of the rollout (pilot -> prod). Can you include a 3-month trial on the dashboard cap, and then automatically revert to 30 if we don't elect to pay up?

Also — procurement would like any concession spelled out as a credit schedule (e.g., X% discount applied as prepaid dollar credits applied monthly) rather than an ad-hoc invoice line so our accounting can accept it.

Will wait for your consolidated proposal. If it's easier, Ben and I can hop on a 30-min call tomorrow morning to walk the numbers.

Thanks,
Claudia

Claudia Vega
Head of Data Platforms
ZenHealth
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-09-20T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Retention capacity & dashboard licensing — packaging proposal and discount ask

Olga / Jordan —

Quick notes after I reviewed Olga's SKU and Claudia's follow-ups:

- Overage model: we can do per-GB billing for overage but offer a 10% effective discount if they prepay a 6-month slab (this is common for orgs wanting predictability). The accounting folks prefer credits applied against monthly invoices; we can provide a prepaid credit schedule that consumes at invoice time.
- Incident sampling bump to 25%: we should offer an automatic short-term elevated sampling policy (up to 72 hrs) that falls into a separate overage bucket billed at a slightly higher rate (e.g., +20% on standard per-GB) — that protects our capacity and keeps costs downstream visible. Also recommend adding a clause: we exempt emergency security/compliance events from overage charges if agreed in advance.
- Dashboard trial: fine to include a 3-month pilot for 40 dashboards, but make it explicit: if they exceed 40 they pay the overage rate per dashboard; after the 3 months, roll down to 30 unless they opt into paid capacity.

Concession bands we can offer without exec sign-off: up to 18% off list for bundled observability (retention + tracing + dashboards) with a 6-12 month prepaid commit. Anything deeper (20%+) needs approval from Marissa/RevOps.

I can draft a table that maps usage bands to effective blended rates (commit vs on-demand) — will attach to the quote.

Ben

--
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Claudia Vega <claudia@zenhealth.io>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>, ZenHealth Procurement <procurement@zenhealth.io>
Date: 2027-09-22T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Retention capacity & dashboard licensing — packaging proposal and discount ask

Hi Claudia and ZenHealth team —

Thanks for the clear list of asks. Per our internal review, here's the consolidated proposal we can send as a single quote. I'm including the key commercial terms up front so you can share with procurement: 

1) Pricing & commit structure (summary):
- 6-month prepaid commit for observability bundle (Retention + Tracing + Advanced Dashboards). Commit: 8 TB/month retention, 20M spans/day sampled at 10%.
- Effective bundled discount: 16% off list across the three components when prepaid for 6 months. Credits will be applied monthly against each invoice (prepaid credit schedule attached).

2) Overage & sampling policy:
- Standard overage: billed per-GB for retention beyond commit at published overage rate.
- Incident sampling bump (up to 72 hours at 25%): auto-enabled, billed into a discrete incident bucket at +20% premium on per-GB equivalent. If incident qualifies as security/compliance emergency (mutually agreed), we will waive incident overage charges for up to two incidents during the first year.

3) Dashboard pilot:
- 3-month pilot for up to 40 dashboards (no charge). After pilot, default cap = 30 dashboards. If you want to retain 40+ dashboards after pilot, we will convert the delta into a monthly dashboard add-on fee (per-dashboard rate included in the attached table).

4) Crediting & accounting:
- Prepaid credits drawn monthly; unused retention credits may be rolled forward within the 12-month window but not beyond the 12-month term. Unused credits cannot be transferred to another account.

5) Next steps & deliverables:
- We will upload a formal quote (HubSpot) and a Payable schedule with the crediting table by EOD Monday.
- If acceptable, we can implement the 3-month dashboard pilot on 2027-10-03 with a short onboarding checklist.

Attachments: redwood-observability-sku-2027.pdf, prepaid-credit-schedule.csv

Claudia — please let us know if procurement wants this as a single DocuSign or prefer a PO + invoice flow. We're happy to accommodate either.

Best,
Marissa
